## ioBroker.sax-power 1.2.0

This release adds transparent battery statistics and health tracking for SAX Power storage systems.

### Highlights

- Battery model assignment with documented nominal and usable capacities
- SAX-reported and calculated equivalent full cycles per device and for the complete system
- Persistent battery-health estimation from qualified discharge runs
- Visible counters for valid, required and rejected health runs
- Clear separation between `devices.<serial>.*` and `summary.*`
- Redesigned administration interface without redundant static version labels
- Fixed password persistence when saving unrelated settings
- Complete documentation of formulas, validation rules, data sources and limitations

The battery-health value is explicitly an estimate. It becomes available only after five qualified discharge runs and remains clearly distinguished from values reported directly by SAX Power.
